items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Dick Voynow said take the kid over and get him a new horn... we'd go on the job at night and play these numbers... Dick Voynow, we did a little vaudeville around the area there with the band.

ctx.x: That's it. So I went. I had not met Bix as yet. So I got there and Dick Voynow said rehearsal is two o'clock this afternoon. And I checked into this hotel there. I've forgotten the name of it right now, I'll think of it later. And we went over the rehearsal and he said, well what do you

play? And I told him, well anything you want, you guys have made records of. "Copenhagen you know, and "Need Some Petting" and so on and so forth." River Boat Shuffle." So we went ahead and we decided to play the numbers. And they were quite surprised that I knew all the numbers. You know, they were just flipping. Well do you know such and such? Do you know this tune and that tune? Sure, so I played. All the ensembles I had down. When it came time for my solo I played my own solo.
